metadata.description: Enterprise-ready Copilot agent plugins for release readiness, secure coding, and developer onboarding. Works in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the GitHub Copilot app.

plugins.name: ship-ready
plugins.description: Release-readiness copilot: go/no-go checks, semver suggestions, changelog drafts, and guardrails for risky release commands.

plugins.name: secure-code
plugins.description: Security guardian: blocks secrets and dangerous commands before they land, scans for OWASP Top 10 patterns, and guides fast, minimal fixes so code ships safely.

plugins.name: onboarding-buddy
plugins.description: Day-one onboarding mentor: maps the codebase, verifies your toolchain, finds setup steps and code owners, and suggests a first task so new engineers are productive on day one.
